name: @thirdlight/backend
description: Thirdlight M1 backend (docs/contracts/sessions.md, packet 09): the authoring HTTP API + WS transport (sessions.md §4–§8), play session state machine + screenshot/diagnostics relay (§10–§12), bounded session logs and errors (§11), the separate-origin static preview listener with the checked message bridge config (§13), and the admin operations (§6.3; export route lands with the exporter in packet 12). All persistent changes delegate to the workspace service (the sole command executor — dependencies.md §4.3); the transport never mutates files independently. Edges (dependencies.md §4.1): protocol, workspace, project-model (types only), ws, node:http/fs/path/crypto.
